description: This file contains benchmarking code for the 'randen' random number generator implementation within the Abseil library, including functions to measure performance of various components like absorb and generate functions, and the randen engine.

classes.name: AbsorbFn
classes.description: Template struct for benchmarking the absorb function of Randen variants.

classes.name: GenerateFn
classes.description: Template struct for benchmarking the generate function of Randen variants.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: Template struct for benchmarking the randen engine with different unsigned integer types.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Executes the absorb or generate operation multiple times for benchmarking.

methods.name: Print
methods.description: Prints benchmarking results including ticks, time, and throughput.

methods.name: Measure
methods.description: Runs the benchmark for a specific operation and inputs, then prints results.

methods.name: RunAll
methods.description: Sets up and runs all benchmarks, optionally pinning to a CPU core.
